climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A Canary Islands appellation covering the whole island of La Palma. It has three sub-zones: Hoyo de Mazo, Fuencaliente and Norte de la Palma. It gained its DO.
